SELECT 'EDHR_WORK_TASK' AS source_id, LPAD(CAST(mes_pro_edhr_work_task.id AS CHAR),20,'0') AS row_order_key, CAST(mes_pro_edhr_work_task.id AS CHAR) AS business_id, CONCAT('EDHR_WORK_TASK:', mes_pro_edhr_work_task.id) AS task_key, '批记录' AS task_type, 'eDHR工作任务' AS source, CONCAT_WS(' · ', NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(CASE WHEN mes_pro_edhr_work_task.task_code IS NOT NULL AND OCTET_LENGTH(mes_pro_edhr_work_task.task_code) > 0 THEN mes_pro_edhr_work_task.task_code ELSE CONCAT('任务#', mes_pro_edhr_work_task.id) END, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+$'), ''), ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(mes_pro_edhr_work_task.work_order_code, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+$'), ''), ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(mes_pro_edhr_work_task.batch_code, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+$'), ''), ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(mes_pro_edhr_work_task.process_name, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+$'), ''), ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(CASE mes_pro_edhr_work_task.task_type WHEN 'FILL' THEN '填写' WHEN 'REVIEW' THEN '复核' WHEN 'REWORK' THEN '返工' WHEN 'ARCHIVE' THEN '归档' ELSE mes_pro_edhr_work_task.task_type END, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+$'), ''), '')) AS detail, CASE mes_pro_edhr_work_task.status WHEN 'TODO' THEN '待处理' WHEN 'OVERDUE' THEN '已逾期' END AS status_label, mes_pro_edhr_work_task.create_time AS created_at, COALESCE(mes_pro_edhr_work_task.due_time,mes_pro_edhr_work_task.overdue_at) AS due_at, mes_pro_edhr_work_task.task_type AS domain_task_type, mes_pro_edhr_work_task.action_url, CAST(mes_pro_edhr_work_task.batch_execution_id AS CHAR) AS batch_execution_id, CAST(mes_pro_edhr_work_task.batch_task_id AS CHAR) AS batch_task_id, CAST(mes_pro_edhr_work_task.execution_id AS CHAR) AS execution_id, mes_pro_edhr_work_task.business_scope_type, CAST(mes_pro_edhr_work_task.business_scope_id AS CHAR) AS business_scope_id, mes_pro_edhr_work_task.assignee_user_id AS owner_user_id, mes_pro_edhr_work_task.candidate_user_snapshot AS candidate_user_snapshot FROM mes_pro_edhr_work_task WHERE mes_pro_edhr_work_task.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND mes_pro_edhr_work_task.deleted = 0 AND mes_pro_edhr_work_task.status IN ('TODO','OVERDUE')
AND ${batchSql}

SELECT 'WORK_ORDER' AS source_id, LPAD(CAST(w.id AS CHAR),20,'0') AS row_order_key, CAST(w.id AS CHAR) AS business_id, CONCAT('WORK_ORDER:', w.id) AS task_key, '排产' AS task_type, '待排产工单' AS source, CONCAT_WS(' · ', NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(w.code, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+$'), ''), ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(i.name, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+$'), ''), ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(w.batch_code, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+$'), ''), ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(CASE WHEN w.quantity IS NOT NULL AND w.quantity != 0 THEN CONCAT('数量 ', TRIM(TRAILING '.' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(w.quantity AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS CHAR)))) END, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+$'), ''), '')) AS detail, '已确认待排产' AS status_label, w.request_date AS created_at, w.planned_start_time AS due_at, w.code FROM mes_pro_work_order w LEFT JOIN mes_md_item i ON i.id = w.product_id AND i.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE w.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1 AND w.type = 1 AND w.temporary_frozen = 0
